title: Violation.
bodyText: A violation of this article shall be deemed an unfair method of competition or unfair or deceptive trade act or practice in the business of insurance in violation of section 431:13-102.
bodyHtml: [§431:3A-503]  Violation.  A violation of this article shall be deemed an unfair method of competition or unfair or deceptive trade act or practice in the business of insurance in violation of section 431:13-102. [L 2001, c 220, pt of §1]
